treatment.continuity: One continuous read on the screenshot-derived light-blue palette. The wordmark crossfades straight into the real product screen, whose camera settles on the chat area and holds there so the screen is large enough to read; the endcard then crossfades in over the last ten frames. Geist Sans 600 throughout at a large scale, soft 96 bpm mallet pulse with automatic UI ticks on each land event, no voiceover. Every headline is short enough to sit on one line in the left column. The previous API beat was removed: it set the API-and-docs claim over the same chat window on a monitor too small to read, so the claim and the visible material disagreed. Copy is limited to the exact confirmed web fact and supplied CTA; no comparative, pricing, privacy, benchmark or availability language.
